item.title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail

turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

item.tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
answer_sheet.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.

turns.text: Make me a bright, punchy 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge, with a big shocked face on the right and the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest listed option is **one 640px image using Flux 2 Klein, starting at 5 credits** on the free plan. I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.

That would give you:
- **16:9**, approximately **640 × 360**
- A bright gaming background
- A large, invented shocked face on the right
- **“ONE LAST TRY”** in bold lettering on the left

**Ways to keep the cost down:** generate just one small image, with no upscaling or automatic retries. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still thumbnail. This is already the smallest supported image setting; no cheaper generation option is listed.

One caveat: AI-generated lettering can be imperfect. Adding the words yourself in a free editor would guarantee exact spelling without another generation.

The tool lists pricing as “from 5 credits,” and I can’t verify a binding quote or your balance with the available tools. **Would you like to proceed with one 640px generation, or hold off?**

turns.agent:
The account refused the generation because **there aren’t enough credits**. No image was created, and no generation credits were spent.

The smallest option is still **one 640px image, listed from 5 credits**. I won’t retry or switch to anything more expensive.

For a no-credit alternative, I can give you a ready-to-use layout and prompt for a free editor.

style.prompt: Bright, punchy 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. On the RIGHT, a huge close-up of an entirely fictional adult gamer with an exaggerated shocked expression, wide eyes and open mouth, expressive face, dramatic rim lighting. On the LEFT, extremely large, bold, highly legible words reading exactly "ONE LAST TRY", arranged in three stacked lines ONE / LAST / TRY, with thick dark outlines and strong contrast. These are the only words. Vibrant electric blue and yellow with orange accents, energetic abstract video-game obstacle-course background, dynamic lighting and graphic bursts, clean strong composition readable at small thumbnail size. Keep lettering entirely inside frame and separate from face. Polished gaming thumbnail aesthetic, no logos, no watermarks.
